rebaseline_note: SV-CORPUS-GRAD.3.18 (2026-08-09, PGEN-SV-CORPUS-GRAD-0036, release 1.0.178->1.0.179, schema 19->20, ledger SV-0049): +2 in the total and BOTH witness columns. *** THE +2 IS NOT THIS LEAF'S. *** It is arrears from SV-CORPUS-GRAD.3.14b (commit 3e316e3c, release 1.0.178), which added the two rules `in_scope_compiler_directive` (satisfiable under all three profiles) and `in_scope_compiler_directive_sv_only` (declared sv_2017+sv_2023) and did NOT re-baseline this contract -- so `sv_cert_recognized_union_gate` shipped RED and stayed RED for one whole release. Attribution is measured, not inferred: `ast_pipeline --dump-rule-profiles` on the PRE-fix and POST-fix grammars gives an IDENTICAL per-profile census (sv_2017 1354 -> 1354, sv_2023 1373 -> 1373, verilog_2005 1122 -> 1122) with ZERO rules changing their satisfiable-profile set, so this leaf's grammar edit contributes exactly 0; and `git show 6a2c088a:grammars/systemverilog.ebnf` (the .3.9 commit that last set 1352) contains NEITHER new rule, so 1352 + 2 = 1354 is arithmetic over provenance. The accounting is FULLY POSITIVE and lands entirely in witnessed columns: expected_proof 6 UNCHANGED, expected_canonical_unknown 11 UNCHANGED, expected_union_unknown 0 UNCHANGED, expected_union_residual_rules [] UNCHANGED, and fully_certified_via_union stays true -- i.e. both new rules are WITNESSED and no rule became newly unproven. THE DEFECT WORTH KEEPING: this gate is operator-invoked, not in the automatic CI tier, so a census-moving grammar change can leave it red with nothing to say so until the next operator runs it. Routed as CI-PARITY-GATE-ROT.22. --- Prior note (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.3.9, retained because it explains why a TOKEN moves this census at all): a token carries no @profiles gate of its own, only its consumers do, so retiring the two FUSED `##[*]`/`##[+]` literals moved the census under all three profiles even though cycle_delay_range is reachable only through SV-gated SVA; that change was -2 in the same three columns.
done_rule: SV is recognized fully_certified when the multi-config certificate-coverage union UNKNOWN reaches 0. Until then the recognized fully_certified-accounting basis is the sound multi-config union (expected_union_unknown), whose residual rule set must equal expected_union_residual_rules exactly (order-insensitive) and be deterministic (byte-identical) across all declared seeds, with sample_parse_failures=0; the canonical single-config accounting (expected_canonical_unknown) is recorded alongside. The union is sound by construction: a rule is credited only when some config POSITIVELY covers it (a proof or a witness — including the VERILOG-2005-PROFILE.6.7 per-profile ProfileEntryUnreachable/ProfileUnproducibleGate proofs, each independently re-derived), never merely because a profile leaves the rule out of its universe.
